02 About

I'm an integrated Master's student in Data Science at the Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU), specialising in Business Analytics, based in Oslo. My work sits between complex datasets and strategic decisions: machine learning and deep learning, numerical simulation, data engineering pipelines and operations research. I care about models that can be explained, validated and acted on. Beyond the code, I bring leadership from chairing student and youth organisations, local-government experience as a deputy district council member, and the communication skills of a teaching assistant.
